description: Convert a diagram image (flowchart, architecture diagram, org chart, network map — PNG/JPG/WebP file, screenshot, or whiteboard photo) into fully editable Visio (VSDX), PowerPoint (PPTX), draw.io, and SVG files. Every shape, connector, and label becomes a real editable object. Costs 10 LayerBack credits. Returns a job_id; by default waits for completion (~30-60s).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the diagram image (PNG, JPG, or WebP)

wait.description: Wait for the conversion to finish (recommended). If false, poll with get_conversion_status.

name: convert_diagram_image
